[AUDIO: text="Welcome to Portugal. This beautiful country on the western edge of Europe is famous for its stunning coastline, rich history, and welcoming culture. The Algarve in the south boasts dramatic cliffs and crystal-clear waters perfect for swimming and surfing. It's a city full of charm, where you can wander narrow cobblestone streets lined with azulejo tiles, taste authentic pastries at traditional cafes, and watch sunset from a rooftop terrace overlooking the river.

Portugal is home to some of Europe's most spectacular architecture including Belem Tower in Lisbon, a UNESCO World Heritage site built during the Age of Discovery. The northern city of Porto offers wine tasting experiences in cellars where port wine has been aged for centuries.

The food scene highlights fresh seafood, hearty stews like cozido à portuguesa, and world-famous pastries from pastelarias. Don't miss trying the local wines—Porto, Alvarinho, and Vinho Verde are all exceptional choices.

With its warm climate, rich traditions, and passionate people, Portugal remains one of Europe's most beloved destinations for travelers seeking authentic experiences combined with natural beauty.", filename="portugal_tour.wav"]
